title: Win Customers Who Are Unhappy with a Competitor
summary: Find people publicly complaining about a rival, reply helpfully and track the conversations that turn warm.

money_potential.label: Medium
money_potential.basis: Assumes you already have a product people switch to; it adds conversations, not a new offer.
money_potential.note: Money tiers are our estimates (labelled Estimate) of relative earning potential, each with its assumption. They are not promises, income claims or advice. Results depend on your market, offer and effort.

how_it_makes_money: People already shopping for a switch convert faster than cold leads.
A simple CRM keeps follow-ups from slipping.
who_its_for: SaaS founders and service businesses with a clear rival.

stack.name: RedReplier
stack.role: Ranks fresh mentions of your rivals by buying intent.
stack.creator: Grok_Hub_IO

stack.name: Keyword Conversation Finder
stack.role: Finds LinkedIn posts about the problem you solve.
stack.creator: 19Ash82

stack.name: Reply Drafter
stack.role: Drafts a helpful, non-pushy reply in your voice.
stack.creator: kevinace

stack.name: Personal X CRM
stack.role: Logs each conversation in Notion for follow-up.
stack.creator: mattyp

steps: List your top two rivals and the problems you fix better.
Review the ranked mentions each morning.
Pick a few and edit the drafted replies.
Follow up from the CRM a few days later.
guardrails: Nothing is posted publicly without your OK.
Keep daily sending caps low and follow each platform's rules on automation.
